articles.title: She had trouble paying the rent and built herself a 15-square-meter tiny house on wheels for $30,000: she travels across the United States spending $700 on gas
articles.standfirst: Jenna K. spends a year creating her own home on wheels
articles.summary: Jenna K. spends a year creating her own home on wheels
articles.body:
There are decisions in a person’s life that are important, since they shape the future and how they will devote the rest of their days. Jenna K , in an interview for People magazine, revealed how she decided to leave her job and change course because she was having serious trouble paying the rent . For that reason, she chose to make a 180-degree turn and build her own 15-square-meter tiny house .

The young woman admits that, although she couldn’t say she was short of money, she does regret that she was never able to save because of rent payments. “So I hoped to have a house someday , but that became less and less likely. It seemed that wasn’t going to happen for a very long time,” she says.

Given this situation, Jenna K. explains that one day, after reading an article about tiny houses, she chose to follow that path: “ I built the tiny house in a relative’s backyard and then decided to leave my job and travel with it, since it was a tiny house on wheels, and make documentaries about my travels for a year”.

Trained in film, she quit her job and set off to travel the road after spending $30,000 to shape her 15-square-meter home, which weighs about 4,500 kilograms and has electricity, water, and a plumbing system. She admits that her biggest expense is gasoline , although she ended up staying for a year and a half at a campground, where she only paid for Wi-Fi while working as a host. Now, she has her online channel ‘Tiny Home Giant Journey’ and manages the social media for a tiny house company .

“My main job simply consisted of creating content for my channel and helping it grow. And it wasn’t until years later that it could fully support me without the need for a second job ,” she emphasizes.

articles.title: Where to find the best early Black Friday sales? Here are the best deals on TVs, Apple and more products
articles.standfirst: From half-price TVs and discounted Apple products to Nintendo Switch 2 consoles and kitchen appliances
articles.summary: From half-price TVs and discounted Apple products to Nintendo Switch 2 consoles and kitchen appliances
articles.body:
The traditional Black Friday shopping rush may still be days away, but Americans looking to upgrade their electronics, purchase Christmas gifts or replace household appliances already have plenty of opportunities to secure substantial savings.

Amazon, Walmart and Best Buy are among the major retailers competing for shoppers ahead of November 27, with early promotions covering everything from premium TVs and Apple devices to gaming consoles and kitchen essentials.

Some of the most attractive discounts have emerged in the technology sector, where shoppers can find selected TVs at approximately half their regular retail price and popular headphones discounted by hundreds of dollars.

Apple's AirPods Pro 3 have also become a standout offer, with Mashable reporting that Amazon has reduced their price from $249 to $149 ahead of the Thanksgiving weekend.

Although additional promotions could arrive on Black Friday itself, shopping early may help consumers avoid missing out on products with limited availability, particularly those expected to feature prominently on Christmas wish lists.

Best early Black Friday deals

Amazon has emerged as a major destination for early technology discounts, with substantial reductions across several premium brands. Shoppers looking for a new laptop, television or personal audio device can already find several noteworthy offers.

The best early Black Friday technology deals are:

Apple MacBook Air 13-inch M5: $989.10 (save $309.90).

Apple AirPods Pro 3: $149 (save $100).

Apple AirPods Max 2: $419 (save $130).

Apple Watch Series 12 (42mm): $299 (save $100).

Apple iPad Air 11-inch M4: $649 (save $100).

Hisense 65-inch E7 Mini-LED 4K TV: $499.99 (save $500).

TCL 75-inch QM8L Mini-LED 4K TV: $1,397.99 (save $1,602).

LG 48-inch B6 OLED 4K TV: $599.99 (save $600).

Bose QuietComfort headphones: $169 (save $190).

Sony WH-1000XM6 headphones: $348 (save $111.99).

Nintendo Switch 2 at Woot: $469 (save $30).

Consumers considering an iPhone upgrade can also investigate T-Mobile's iPhone 18 Pro promotion , although the advertised offer requires eligible customers to receive billing credits over 36 months.

Where else can shoppers find best Black Friday savings?

Technology isn't the only category receiving significant discounts. Amazon 's early promotions also include the Ninja Crispi Air Fryer for $149.99 and the KitchenAid Classic Stand Mixer for $279.99, representing savings of $30 and $120, respectively.

Coffee enthusiasts can find the Breville Barista Pro Espresso Machine advertised at $564.95, a reduction of $285, while Amazon Prime members can purchase the Echo Time smart clock for $99.99 under an exclusive promotion.

Entertainment subscriptions are also becoming part of the Black Friday competition. Peacock is offering eligible new and returning customers its Select subscription for $2.99 per month for three months or $29.99 for an entire year, although the package excludes live sports.

With Cyber Monday following on November 30, shoppers can expect promotional activity to continue throughout the Thanksgiving weekend.

But, comparing prices across all retailers remains essential. Advertised discounts, stock availability and membership deals can change quickly, as the biggest percentage reduction doesn't always represent the best overall value.

articles.title: Ronald Reagan, 40th U.S. President: "You prove that hard work and determination overcome all obstacles and that despair is unnecessary"
articles.standfirst: The former US president believed perseverance and self-confidence could help individuals confront adversity
articles.summary: The former US president believed perseverance and self-confidence could help individuals confront adversity
articles.body:
Success rarely comes without setbacks, and some of life's most meaningful achievements emerge from periods of uncertainty and disappointment. Ronald Reagan , the 40th president of the United States, captured that relationship between adversity and perseverance in a powerful reflection on human determination.

“You prove that hard work and determination overcome all obstacles and that despair is unnecessary,” Reagan said, expressing a belief in the ability of individuals to confront difficult circumstances without surrendering their ambitions.

The message remains relevant far beyond the political environment in which Reagan built his public reputation. It speaks to anyone facing professional setbacks, personal difficulties or uncertainty about the future, emphasizing the importance of continuing to work toward a meaningful objective.

Reagan 's words also reflect the optimism that became a recognizable characteristic of his political identity throughout his presidency, which lasted from 1981 to 1989.

The story behind Ronald Reagan's comments

Reagan delivered the comment on October 4, 1988, during the presentation ceremony for the Minority Enterprise Development Week Awards , where he recognized the achievements of minority business owners across the United States.

His speech addressed the difficulties facing Americans living in disadvantaged communities, particularly those whose experiences had gradually diminished their confidence in the possibility of a better future.

Reagan argued that successful entrepreneurs could inspire others by demonstrating what was achievable through perseverance, self-confidence and access to economic opportunities.

“What is necessary is self-esteem and self-confidence,” Reagan told his audience.

The president viewed meaningful employment and professional achievement as sources of dignity, believing that individual success could have a positive influence extending beyond the person directly responsible for it.

His message was particularly significant because it acknowledged how repeated disappointment could gradually develop into despair, discouraging individuals from pursuing opportunities that might improve their circumstances.

Why Reagan's message remains relevant today

Nearly four decades later, Reagan 's observation continues to resonate in a society where economic uncertainty, professional competition and personal challenges can make long-term ambitions appear increasingly difficult to achieve.

Hard work doesn't necessarily guarantee success, and many obstacles require additional resources, institutional support or assistance from others. Nevertheless, determination can help individuals identify alternative opportunities when their original plans encounter difficulties.

The quote also highlights the importance of recognizing that temporary setbacks do not necessarily define a person's future. Failure can provide valuable experience, while perseverance can create opportunities that initially appeared beyond reach.

Reagan 's underlying message is ultimately about maintaining hope without ignoring the realities of adversity. His words encourage people to recognize their potential, remain adaptable and continue pursuing meaningful goals even when progress appears uncertain.

articles.title: US tourist dies after tragic altercation with former MMA fighter at Bangkok hotel
articles.standfirst: What began as a complaint about excessive noise ended in tragedy
articles.summary: What began as a complaint about excessive noise ended in tragedy
articles.body:
A fatal confrontation between two foreign visitors at a Bangkok hotel has raised questions about the boundaries of self-defense after an American tourist died following an altercation with a former professional mixed martial arts fighter.

Kalif Edward Harper , a 46-year-old from Michigan, was pronounced dead on Sunday, November 22, after emergency responders were unable to revive him following an incident at the Tim Place Hotel in Bangkok's Phra Khanong area.

Thai police subsequently detained Frank Eric Marques , a 39-year-old Italian-Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu black belt and former MMA fighter who reportedly restrained Harper with a chokehold during the confrontation.

Marques remained at the scene and told investigators that he had acted in self-defense. However, authorities are examining whether his response exceeded the force necessary to protect himself.

The incident reportedly began with a disagreement between Harper and hotel employees over excessive noise, with a receptionist later revealing that she had attempted to resolve the complaint before the confrontation occurred.

What happened before fatal confrontation

Receptionist Khang On Nan Kham Bway , 32, told Viral Press that Harper had been complaining about noise from upstairs when Marques entered the hotel's reception area.

“I told him that if he thought it was too loud, he could move to the fifth floor. We hadn’t even finished talking when the Italian man walked in,” Khang recalled.

According to her account, Marques had been passing through the lobby when Harper approached him, prompting a verbal disagreement that subsequently escalated into a physical confrontation.

“They started exchanging words, but I couldn’t understand exactly what they were saying because they were speaking English,” she explained.

Khang also alleged that Harper had threatened her during an earlier complaint, claiming that his behavior had previously made her concerned about her personal safety.

“The American had threatened me once before, saying that if it was still noisy upstairs, he would cut my throat,” she said.

Those allegations remain subject to investigation, with police reviewing surveillance recordings alongside testimony from hotel employees and other available evidence.

Former MMA fighter faces serious legal questions

Marques , known as Frank the Tank within combat sports circles, reportedly holds a professional MMA record of two victories and one defeat, alongside his qualifications in Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu.

According to The Pattaya News, Thai police were proceeding with a murder charge against the Italian despite his assertion that he had acted in self-defense.

Investigators must establish whether the circumstances justified his use of force and whether his actions were proportionate to the threat he allegedly faced.

Harper 's body has been transferred for a forensic examination, with authorities yet to establish a definitive cause of death. Police have also contacted the US Embassy in Bangkok regarding notification of his family.

While preliminary accounts suggest Harper initiated the physical confrontation, responsibility for his death remains a matter for investigators and the judicial process.

Marques has maintained that he was defending himself, and no court has determined his criminal responsibility.

articles.title: Who's performing at the 2026 Macy's Thanksgiving Parade? Complete lineup for this year's celebration
articles.standfirst: The iconic New York celebration marks its 100th edition
articles.summary: The iconic New York celebration marks its 100th edition
articles.body:
A century of Thanksgiving tradition will be celebrated on the streets of New York City on Thursday, November 26, as the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade marks its 100th edition with an extensive entertainment lineup befitting the historic occasion.

Country music sensation Megan Moroney and singer Teddy Swims will headline performances outside Macy's Herald Square flagship store, while artists representing generations and musical genres will entertain spectators along the parade route.

Among the most anticipated moments will be a special tribute to Dolly Parton , led by Broadway performer Megan Hilty . Singer and songwriter EJAE will also deliver a featured performance during the anniversary celebration.

The musical entertainment will accompany a massive collection of floats, marching bands and a record 100 inflatable elements, combining contemporary popular culture with characters that helped establish the parade's enduring appeal.

Performers at 2026 Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade

Macy's has assembled a diverse musical lineup featuring internationally recognized artists, TV personalities and Broadway talent. The announced performers include:

- Jimmy Fallon & The Roots

Several familiar television and entertainment personalities will also make special appearances, including Melissa Joan Hart, Jack McBrayer, Janet McTeer, Holly Robinson Peete and Rodney Peete .

Marching bands from across the United States will provide additional entertainment, including the University of Alabama's Million Dollar Band , the University of Connecticut Marching Band and the University of Illinois Marching Illini .

Performances from the Divine Nine Unity Step Team, Native Pride Productions, Spirit of America Cheer, Spirit of America Dance and the Maria Verdeja School of the Arts will further expand the celebration.

When and where to watch Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade 2026

The Thanksgiving Day festivities begin at 8:30 a.m. on Thursday, November 26, with NBC, Telemundo and Peacock providing coverage until noon in all US time zones.

Savannah Guthrie, Hoda Kotb and Al Roker will lead NBC's broadcast, while Andrea Meza, Aleyda Ortiz and Clovis Nienow will present the Spanish-language coverage on Telemundo.

Spectators attending in person will see the procession begin near West 77th Street and Central Park West before making its way through Manhattan toward Herald Square.

The centennial edition will also welcome back historic balloon characters, including Felix the Cat, Blue Hippopotamus and Underdog , which last appeared in the parade in 1984.

New designs featuring Sorcerer's Apprentice Mickey, Bluey, Hello Kitty and Buckaroo Bob the Minion will join the procession, alongside floats celebrating the event's extensive history.

As tradition dictates, Santa Claus will bring the parade to its conclusion, officially ushering in the Christmas shopping season. NBC will also broadcast an encore presentation at 2 p.m. ET/PT.

articles.title: Mega Millions Winning Numbers: Results for Tuesday, November 24 drawing of the $645 Million Jackpot
articles.standfirst: Tuesday's drawing offers one of the biggest Mega Millions prizes of 2026
articles.summary: Tuesday's drawing offers one of the biggest Mega Millions prizes of 2026
articles.body:
A Thanksgiving week celebration could take on an entirely different meaning for one American lottery player on Tuesday, November 24, as the Mega Millions jackpot reaches an estimated $645 million following another drawing without a grand prize winner.

Friday's unsuccessful jackpot drawing pushed the prize closer to $650 million , with Tuesday's potential winner being offered a choice between the full advertised amount in annual installments or an immediate cash payment of approximately $270.8 million before taxes .

The growing jackpot is among the biggest Mega Millions prizes of 2026, although it remains some distance behind the $803 million won by a Florida ticket holder in July, the largest Mega Millions jackpot awarded this year.

Tuesday's drawing is scheduled for 11 p.m. ET , with official results expected shortly afterward. The winning numbers will determine whether the jackpot has finally been claimed or continues growing ahead of the Thanksgiving holiday weekend.

Mega Millions winning numbers for Tuesday, November 24, 2026

The winning numbers for Tuesday's $645 million Mega Millions jackpot are pending, with the drawing scheduled to take place at 11 p.m. ET.

During the previous drawing on Friday, November 20, the winning white ball numbers were 32, 35, 48, 58 and 61, while the gold Mega Ball was 21. No ticket matched all six numbers.

However, six players successfully matched four white balls and the Mega Ball. Their respective prize multipliers increased their winnings to amounts ranging from $20,000 to $100,000 before taxes.

The odds of winning the Mega Millions jackpot stand at approximately one in 290.5 million, while the lottery offers eight additional prize categories involving different combinations of matching numbers.

How much would the $645 million Mega Millions winner actually take home?

The difference between the advertised jackpot and the eventual payout could be substantial, particularly if the winner follows the popular approach of accepting an immediate lump sum rather than annual installments.

According to Forbes, the estimated $270.8 million cash option would initially be reduced to approximately $205.8 million following the mandatory 24% federal tax withholding.

The winner's eventual federal income tax obligations could reduce that amount further to approximately $170.6 million . Additional state and local taxes may apply depending on where the winning ticket was purchased and the winner's individual circumstances.

Choosing the annuity would provide 30 payments , with each successive annual installment increasing by 5% . Forbes estimates that the total payout after federal taxes could reach approximately $406.3 million over the payment period.

Should Tuesday's drawing produce another rollover, the next opportunity for the jackpot to be claimed will come on Friday, November 27, when Mega Millions holds its regularly scheduled Black Friday drawing.

articles.title: Barnes and Noble Black Friday sale: Best deals, discounts and opening time this Friday
articles.standfirst: Book lovers can already shop early online before brick-and-mortar stores open their doors on November 27
articles.summary: Book lovers can already shop early online before brick-and-mortar stores open their doors on November 27
articles.body:
Bookworms and holiday gift shoppers do not have to wait until the Thanksgiving leftovers are packed away to start crossing titles off their wish lists.

Barnes & Noble has already rolled out its 2026 Black Friday and Cyber Monday event online at BarnesandNoble.com, offering steep markdowns across bestselling fiction, nonfiction, young adult box sets, vinyl records, and boutique gifts through Monday, November 30, 2026.

Still, for readers hoping to browse the aisles in person, or snag coveted in-store exclusives, knowing when local doors unlock on Friday morning is essential.

All Barnes & Noble retail locations across the United States close on Thanksgiving Day, Thursday, November 26, before reopening for Black Friday on Friday, November 27.

Because the bookseller operates both standalone street-level stores and locations inside enclosed shopping malls, exact opening hours vary by neighborhood.

Most standalone Barnes & Noble stores open early on Black Friday, typically at 8:00 a.m. or 9:00 a.m. local time, roughly an hour ahead of standard weekday schedules, while mall-based stores align with their shopping center’s holiday opening time.

Shoppers planning an early morning visit should confirm their nearest branch’s schedule via the online Store Locator, especially since Black Friday morning traditionally marks the in-store debut of Barnes & Noble ’s annual Signed Editions collection, where limited quantities of autographed books sell on a first-come, first-served basis.

Top Black Friday book, collectible, and media deals available right now

articles.title: Powerball Winning Numbers: Results for Wednesday, November 25 drawing for the $30 million jackpot
articles.standfirst: Powerball’s grand prize climbed past the $30 million mark to an estimated $31 million annuity ahead of Wednesday’s 10:59 p.m. ET Thanksgiving Eve drawing
articles.summary: Powerball’s grand prize climbed past the $30 million mark to an estimated $31 million annuity ahead of Wednesday’s 10:59 p.m. ET Thanksgiving Eve drawing
articles.body:
Lottery players hoping to kick off the Thanksgiving holiday with a multimillion-dollar windfall have their eyes fixed on tonight’s Powerball drawing.

Scheduled for Wednesday, November 25, 2026, at 10:59 p.m. ET (3:59 a.m. GMT on Thursday, November 26) at the Florida Lottery draw studio in Tallahassee, Florida, tonight’s drawing features an estimated $31 million grand prize, with a lump-sum cash option worth $13 million before federal and state tax withholdings.

Because the live broadcast has not yet taken place, the official winning numbers for Wednesday night remain pending and will be posted immediately once the balls drop.

Tonight’s jackpot climbed above the $30 million threshold after Monday night’s November 23 drawing ended without a top-prize winner.

Following a $114 million jackpot win on Saturday, November 21, the game had reset to its $20 million starting prize for Monday’s drawing, where the winning numbers drawn were 7, 9, 27, 40, and 58, with a red Powerball of 19 and a 2X Power Play multiplier. In Monday’s separate Double Play drawing, the winning numbers were 35, 36, 40, 48, and 51, with a Double Play Powerball of 3.

Although nobody hit the jackpot or matched all five white balls for the $1 million second-tier prize on Monday, more than 283,857 tickets nationwide won cash prizes, including 11 tickets that matched four white balls plus the red Powerball to win $50,000, and two additional Power Play tickets that doubled that payout to $100,000.

How to play Powerball tonight, ticket deadlines, and all nine prize tiers

Players looking to enter Wednesday night’s Thanksgiving Eve drawing must purchase their tickets before their local jurisdiction’s cutoff deadline, which typically closes one to two hours prior to the 10:59 p.m. ET broadcast.

Standard Powerball tickets cost $2 per play across 45 U.S. states, Washington, D.C., Puerto Rico, and the U.S. Virgin Islands, as well as in the United Kingdom, where Powerball ticket sales expanded in July 2026, while tickets in Idaho and Montana start at $3 because the Power Play feature is automatically included.

To play, participants pick five white-ball numbers between 1 and 69 and one red Powerball number from 1 to 26, or opt for a computer-generated “Quick Pick.”

For an extra $1 per play, adding Power Play multiplies non-jackpot prizes by 2X, 3X, 4X, 5X, or 10X, with the 10X multiplier active tonight because the advertised jackpot sits below $150 million, and automatically boosts the Match 5 prize to $2 million.

Players in participating jurisdictions can also add Double Play for another $1, entering their numbers into a second drawing with a $10 million top prize.

Across the main Powerball drawing, players can win across nine prize levels with overall odds of 1 in 24.87:

- Match 5 white balls + Powerball: Grand Prize ($31 million estimated annuity) — Odds: 1 in 292,201,338

- Match 5 white balls only: $1,000,000 ($2,000,000 with Power Play) — Odds: 1 in 11,688,053.52

- Match 4 white balls + Powerball: $50,000 — Odds: 1 in 913,129.18

- Match 4 white balls only: $100 — Odds: 1 in 36,525.17

- Match 3 white balls + Powerball: $100 — Odds: 1 in 14,494.11

- Match 3 white balls only: $7 — Odds: 1 in 579.76

- Match 2 white balls + Powerball: $7 — Odds: 1 in 701.33

- Match 1 white ball + Powerball: $4 — Odds: 1 in 91.98

- Match red Powerball only: $4 — Odds: 1 in 38.32

Fans can watch tonight’s drawing live on local television stations or stream it directly on Powerball.com . Should a ticket match all six numbers, the winner can choose between a one-time lump sum or an annuity paid out over 30 graduated installments across 29 years.

articles.title: VIDEO: Former President Joe Biden has changed significantly in physical appearance
articles.summary: Less than two years after leaving the White House, Joe Biden is leading a very different life. The former president, who turned 84 on November 20, was spotted alongside his wife Jill at Philadelphia International Airport.
articles.body:
Less than two years after leaving the White House, Joe Biden is leading a very different life. The former president, who turned 84 on November 20, was spotted alongside his wife Jill at Philadelphia International Airport.

Biden has reduced his public engagements since being diagnosed with advanced prostate cancer in May 2025. He even scaled back promotional events for his recently released presidential memoir to prioritize his treatment.

The footage emerged as the Biden family reportedly prepared to continue its annual Thanksgiving tradition in Nantucket, something they have been doing for more than 50 years.

articles.title: A Florida man bought an abandoned town in California for $1.4 million: Eight years later, here's how his life has changed
articles.standfirst: Eight years after risking his life savings on a forgotten mining town, he's still determined to bring it back to life
articles.summary: Eight years after risking his life savings on a forgotten mining town, he's still determined to bring it back to life
articles.body:
What started as an unexpected property listing has completely transformed Brent Underwood's life. In 2018, the Florida -born entrepreneur took an extraordinary financial gamble, purchasing Cerro Gordo, an abandoned mining town in California , for $1.4 million.

Eight years later, he's still committed to the remote settlement, having traded the comforts of the city for a life dedicated to rebuilding a piece of American history.

Underwood was living in Austin, Texas, when a friend sent him the listing as something of a joke. Having previously operated a bed-and-breakfast in a Victorian property, he was already interested in historic buildings and hospitality. Cerro Gordo, however, presented an opportunity on a different scale.

More than just one historic property, he could potentially bring an entire forgotten community back to life. Interested in the idea, he researched the settlement, travelled to California and eventually secured the purchase.

The financial commitment was enormous. Underwood didn't have the money to buy the town outright, relying on a high-interest loan, his life savings and contributions from friends.

“The whole project has been a big risk from day one,” he told People. “I pushed all of my savings into this project without a super clear path to make it back.”

He had no professional background in mining or construction either. The risk was considerable, but he saw the challenge as an opportunity to push himself beyond his existing experience.

Eight years later, a risky purchase has become a lifelong mission

The years since the purchase have brought significant changes. Underwood eventually moved to Cerro Gordo full-time, spending six years living in the isolated settlement.

Situated around 8,200 feet above sea level near Death Valley, the town offers little of the convenience associated with modern living. There's no running water or mobile phone coverage, while the nearest grocery store is approximately two hours away.

Winter can be particularly demanding, with heavy snowfall and difficult access sometimes leaving him stranded for days. Even basic tasks require advance planning, and maintaining ageing buildings in such a remote location presents its own challenges.

Nevertheless, restoring properties and uncovering the settlement's past have become central to his everyday life.

One particularly memorable discovery came when he found a briefcase hidden beneath dusty boxes in the old general store. Its contents included mining claims, financial records, love letters and legal documents, revealing the personal story of a former resident who had repeatedly tried to make a living in the mountains.

Underwood says he identified with the miner's determination, recognizing similarities between the man's ambitions and his own uncertain journey.

His restoration efforts have also attracted a substantial online audience. Through TikTok, Instagram and YouTube, he shares discoveries, construction projects and the realities of living in a ghost town. His following has grown into the millions, bringing international attention to Cerro Gordo.

Meanwhile, plans to develop visitor accommodation and restore historic buildings continue, including rebuilding the American Hotel, which was destroyed by fire in 2020.

Although the financial pressures haven't disappeared and the original investment remains a significant commitment, Underwood believes the experience has been worth it.
